notes.title: TBE Release
notes.content:
[p][b]New Tasks for the Architect.[/b]
New assignments for the Interior Designer have been added.
Realistic weather has been added, including rain, thunderstorms, and fog. Many new locations for construction.
TO BE CONTINUED! There will be lots of updates and additions in the game!
Music has been added to the game depending on the time of day. Nature sounds now vary at different times of day. Volume control is now available in the menu, with separate settings for music and nature sounds.

notes.title: RELEASE
notes.content: RELEASE of the game TBE

notes.title: Fixed a bug. Added 3 new tasks
notes.content:
[p][b][i]Greetings, brave one.[/i][/b][i]
Have you agreed to take on the challenge of furnishing our first non-standard public facilities? Respect! There’s no turning back now… we’re counting on you 😊
The Mayor wants Rescue Service 733 to be up and running at the first plaza in the city.
We hope your interior design skills are just as strong as your architectural ones. 
[b]GIVE IT A SHOT.[/b]
Your reward will be: [b]Level 1 Interior Designer Certificate.[/b]
[b]We believe in you!
[/b][/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760782/6f504e7dfaf87d3f628c13d20abc7367c9d0fcc7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Greetings, Brave One![/b]
The Mayor wants to see the [b]Research Laboratory[/b] up and running on the first plaza of the city.
[b]GIVE IT A TRY[/b][/p][p]The reward will be:
– A [b]Level 2 Interior Designer Certificate[/b][/p][p]If you decorate the interior with [b]additional items[/b], you’ll receive a [b]special gift personally from the Mayor[/b]. Try to use your skills and find extra fitting objects.
We believe in you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760782/7980547340fedce99d6544a7e1655b2c908b7681.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Welcome Architect[/b]
New challenges await you.
Try creating a Park Playground on the shore of our beautiful lake.
You have amazing equipment for this. Combine them in different ways and make something unique. It will be fun.
Find it in the [i]Entertainment – Outdoor[/i] section.
If you succeed – there will be a reward. The Mayor promised drinks and sweets!
Minimum required: slide, swing, merry-go-round, play structures.
[b][i]
[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760782/4f6f57db35a45a66687b1ce7aa319deacb87af69.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Building Editor First Showcase - DEV Stream!
notes.content:
Best opportunity to checkout the gameplay of our upcoming Building Simulator. 
We will be demonstrating all available features, talking about exiting things in development, accepting requests and answering questions. Come and chat with us about design, architecture and landscape.
